Experiment 45 complete:

**Result**: `val_pref_acc: 0.464` (vs current best 0.494 from exp42)

**Outcome**: discard, reverted to exp42 commit `1437535`.

**What I tried**: Bumped `adam_beta1` from default 0.9 → 0.95 (RLHF-style smoother momentum), pairing it with the already-set `adam_beta2=0.95`.

**Why it didn't work**: The smoother first-moment estimate likely slowed effective adaptation in our short ~10-min training budget. With the standard `beta1=0.9`, the model picks up gradient direction faster — important when training time is the bottleneck. Lowering momentum responsiveness paired with already-low `beta2` made the optimizer too sluggish to converge well within the budget.

The result was logged to `results.tsv` and the experiment commit was reset.
